name: agentscope
description: CLI-first coding-agent trace observability with extensible reporters.

scripts.lint: pnpm verify:targets && pnpm verify:quality && eslint scripts *.mjs vitest.config.ts --max-warnings=0 && nx run-many -t lint --all
scripts.test:unit: pnpm verify:targets && pnpm test:workspace-policy && nx run-many -t test --all
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter @agentscope/integration build && pnpm --filter @agentscope/integration prepare:candidate && pnpm --filter @agentscope/integration maintain:artifacts && AGENTSCOPE_INTEGRATION_FULL=1 pnpm --filter @agentscope/integration select && pnpm --filter @agentscope/integration prepare:images && pnpm --filter @agentscope/integration prepare:model-routes && pnpm --filter @agentscope/integration run:scenarios && pnpm --filter @agentscope/integration maintain:artifacts
scripts.verify:workspace: pnpm verify:review-skill && pnpm --filter agentscope-cli verify:docs && node scripts/verify-workspace-policy.mjs && pnpm verify:targets
scripts.validate: pnpm verify:workspace && pnpm verify:acceptance-evidence && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm coverage && pnpm build && pnpm verify:cli-artifact && pnpm verify:native-candidate
